name: com.imoving/moving-quotes
title: iMoving - moving quotes
description: Real moving prices from vetted US movers by ZIP codes, move size and date, with booking links.

tools.name: list_move_sizes
tools.description: Lists the home sizes iMoving prices moves for - a few items, a studio, an apartment or a house from 1 to 5+ bedrooms - each with its id, the truck it needs and the typical volume of belongings in cubic feet. Call it before get_moving_quote to pick move_size_id; the list rarely changes.

tools.name: get_moving_quote
tools.description: Gets moving costs - binding price quotes from licensed and insured moving companies - for a home move within the United States: local, long-distance, interstate or cross-country, an apartment or a house. Returns how many movers serve the route, the price range, and the best offers (the cheapest, plus the top-rated mover) with rating, reviews, price and a booking_url. Use it when someone asks how much a move costs, wants a moving estimate, or is looking for movers to hire. Nothing is booked or stored.

from_zip.description: 5-digit US ZIP code of the place being moved out of, e.g. "33101".

to_zip.description: 5-digit US ZIP code of the destination, e.g. "10001".

move_size_id.description: The id of the home size, from list_move_sizes.

move_date.description: Moving day as YYYY-MM-DD, from tomorrow up to 18 months ahead.

limit.description: How many of the cheapest offers to return, 1-10. Default 5.

tools.name: get_mover
tools.description: Gets a moving company's profile from iMoving: where it is based, years in business, moves done, its rating (1-10) and its most recent verified customer reviews (1-5 stars each). Use it to check a mover's reputation before choosing one, with the mover_id of an offer from get_moving_quote.

mover_id.description: mover_id of an offer from get_moving_quote.
